item.title: I²S Audio Speaker
item.description:
The i2s_audio speaker platform allows you to receive audio via the the I²S Audio Component.

This platform only works on ESP32 based chips.

Warning

Audio and voice components consume a significant amount of resources (RAM, CPU) on the device.

Crashes are likely to occur if you include too many additional components in your device’s configuration. In particular, Bluetooth/BLE components are known to cause issues when used in combination with Voice Assistant and/or other audio components.

item.title: Mixer Speaker
item.description:
The mixer speaker platform allows you to mix audio sent to different source speakers into one output which is sent to another speaker component. Individual source speakers may be ducked (made quieter) with the apply ducking action.

When mixing multiple audio streams into one, they must have the same sample rate. If they are different, enable queue mode so that only one source speaker’s audio is played at a time. Otherwise, use a resampler speaker to send audio to the source speakers.

item.title: Resampler Speaker
item.description:
The resampler speaker platform allows you to convert the sample rate of an audio stream and output it to another speaker component.

If the audio stream doesn’t require resampling, it is automatically sent directly to the output speaker.

This platform only works on ESP32 based chips.

Warning

Audio and voice components consume a significant amount of resources (RAM and CPU) on the device.

Crashes are likely to occur if you include too many additional components in your device’s configuration. In particular, Bluetooth/BLE components are known to cause issues when used in combination with Voice Assistant and/or other audio components.
